From spreadsheets to an integrated finance platform: reinsurance income on Odoo 16

National reinsurance company, Indonesia  |  IT Business Analyst and Odoo developer  |  February 2025 to present

Premium income was tracked across a legacy core system, a desktop accounting package and a stack of Excel workpapers, linked by XML files and wet signatures. I wrote the Functional Specification Document and built the modules that replace that chain: 106 requirements, 59 use cases, 41 general rules and 22 custom Odoo modules.

    1. ProblemDisconnected systemsXML transfers, manual re-keying, workpapers for SOA, VAT and production.
    2. AnalysisGAP, RACI, To BeSix process areas, 19 activities mapped to roles, one high-level target picture.
    3. DesignFSD to company standardUse cases, access matrix for 41 submodules and 11 roles, verification activity, process flows.
    4. Build22 Odoo modulesRates, notes, receipts, multi-currency settlement, reconciliation, reports, dashboard.

    Design decisions worth explaining

    Post the receipt first, verify afterwards

    The cash is already in the bank and evidenced by the bank mutation, so the journal is posted immediately. Verification and endorsement review the recording instead of permitting it, which keeps the bank position current without waiting for signatures.

    Book the exchange difference inside the payment entry

    Notes are booked at the monthly rate while payments use the rate of the day. The difference is an extra line in the same payment entry, so each settlement reads as one traceable journal.

    Let the core system own document numbers

    Odoo never numbers premium or claim notes itself and refuses to post a note without the core-system number. The payment reference copies that number, so every receivable line points back to its source.

    Park shortfalls in suspense instead of forcing a match

    When a cedant pays less while a credit note is still pending, reconciliation is allowed and the remainder stays in a dedicated suspense account until the credit note arrives.

    Keep Excel, but only behind validation

    Templates with instructions, parse, an editable preview with error flags, then confirm. A failure in one document never cancels the rest of the file.

    Modules I built

    Behind the case study: 22 custom Odoo 16 modules and one modified third-party module, each answering a requirement in the specification. Names are simplified and client details removed.

    in development

    IFRS 17 readiness: two charts of accounts, side by side

    The ledger has to speak both the local standard in use today and IFRS 17. The design keeps the existing PSAK 104 chart of accounts running and adds an IFRS 17 chart of accounts with 15-digit codes, with every PSAK 104 account mapped to an IFRS 17 account.

    Chart of accountsPSAK 104existing accounts, still in use
    Mapping
    Chart of accountsIFRS 17new accounts, 15-digit codes
    • One mapping per account. A dedicated COA mapping module links each PSAK 104 account to its IFRS 17 account, both taken from the Chart of Accounts.
    • Clear system boundary. IFRS 17 journals are generated by the CSM engine, not computed in Odoo.

    Foundation and master data 5

    • Partner profilingBusiness relation, code, currency and an auto-generated Partner Code on every contact, with automatic tags.
    • Currency rate typesBooking, tax and settlement rates with validity periods; notes must use the booking rate.
    • File upload widgetOne reusable Excel upload widget shared by every import wizard.
    • External document numberingDocument numbers come from the core system, and confirming a note without one is blocked.
    • Technical journal typeAdds a "Technical" type to journals.

    Note integration and import 3

    • Note import wizardExcel import of notes in three steps: Parse, Preview, Confirm, using the booking rate.
    • Excel-based note filterFilters the note list from an uploaded Excel file, replacing the standard upload button.
    • Partner importImports partner master data from Excel.

    Receipts and settlement 5

    • Bank journal direction numberingBR/BD/CR/CD running numbers by the direction of each bank and cash transaction.
    • Bank statement displayAmount column, balances hidden by department, and status and posting actions.
    • Note settlement selectorPick the notes to settle and the settlement rate; exchange and payment differences land on dedicated accounts in the same entry.
    • Payment vouchersBRV/BDV/CRV/CDV voucher printouts in A4 and A5, plus cheques.
    • Suspense reconciliationReconciles with the remaining amount parked in a suspense account, extending an OCA reconciliation module.

    Note accounting 3

    • Discount account per productEach product carries its own discount account, so notes book gross income plus a separate discount line.
    • Booking rate correctionAn action to rebook notes that were posted with the wrong booking rate.
    • Note print layoutsVoucher-style note printouts with underwriting year and taxes, and landscape journal entries.

    Reporting 5

    • Statement of AccountStatement of Account per partner, with export.
    • VAT reportVAT at 11% and 12% using the tax rate, including premium discounts.
    • Production reportProduction per product, with export.
    • Aged receivable and payableDetail screens replacing the standard pop-up: aging from due date, revaluation at the booking rate, Excel and PDF.
    • Credit control dashboardAging analysis, top 5 customers and collection trend, with filters, PDF and Excel.

    Collection 1

    • Receipt follow-upOverdue receipt printouts and emails, follow-up emails, and a personal follow-up list.

    Modified third-party 1

    • Document approvalA third-party approval module, modified for this project.
